rei: FYI hit a weird one in the sampleapp rerank flow during onboarding: some batches return dim mismatch after the auth-refactor.
mira: What does the error look like?
rei: Server: 
```
400 Bad Request: embedding dimension mismatch expected=768 got=512 at item_index=2
```
sdk-bot: Note: node-sdk v0.9.2 introduced an auth retry wrapper.
leo: Could be two issues: (1) SDK returning 512 when a quantized fallback is used, (2) batch helper dropping empty docs and shifting order.
rei: Repro: run docker quickstart, send mixed empty+short docs. Node sampleapp preserves slots as [] while python removes them so rerank gets misaligned.
mira: Short-term patch: batch helper should emit explicit null placeholders so order preserved; SDK should normalize vector length by padding/truncating to model_profile.dim before handing off to rerank.
leo: Also add idempotency key on batch POSTs so auth retries don't create duplicates.
rei: I'll open sampleapp PR and a small parity test.
mira: Please add a server-side validation payload change request so clients get JSON {"error":"InvalidEmbeddingShape","expected":768,"got":512,"index":2} instead of free text.
sdk-bot: CI: sampleapp/integration #77 failed (rerank parity) https://ci.redwood/77
leo: Thanks, keep notes in the PRs. If anyone else sees this, dump the routing header + model name here.
